mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, signaling strengthening supply chains, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as companies benefit from increased efficiency.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 2% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating slowing demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above 200, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in two consecutive months, signaling labor market weakness, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors react to potential economic slowdown.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE increases by > 0.5% over 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the level of retail and food services sales (RSAFS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong consumer spending supports economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
